lead.caption: A Long March 2F lifts Shenzhou-24 from Jiuquan at 08:18; docking at 11:56 Beijing time.
lead.fact: First Pakistani in orbit • Docked 11:56 Beijing time
lead.headline: Shenzhou-24 docks with first Pakistani aboard
lead.summary: A Long March 2F lifts off from Jiuquan at 08:18 Beijing time with Tang Hongbo, Wu Yi and Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali — the first foreign astronaut aboard Tiangong. Docking follows at 11:56, three and a half hours later.
